title: Channel creator lobbies
description: Whoever joins a lobby gets their own temporary voice channel — up to 10 lobbies, each with its own name and user limit (e.g. Duo, Squad).
howItWorks: Pick a voice channel as the lobby. New channels go into the lobby's category; the bot needs Manage Channels and Move Members there.
templateHint: '{name}' — the member, '{game}' — what they play, '{n}' — number. Empty = default name.
full: You've reached the maximum of {max} lobbies — remove one first.
legacyHint: Change it under Settings → Voice & stats.
removeText: The channel stays as a normal voice channel; temporary channels already open stay until they empty.

server.full: You can have at most {max} lobbies.
server.added: Lobby added — the bot picks it up within ~15 seconds.
server.updated: Lobby updated — the bot picks it up within ~15 seconds.
